message.content:
Pet waste bags are plastic (polyethylene) bags, so they fall under heading 3923, "Articles for the conveyance or packing of goods, of plastics." Subheading 3923.21 covers sacks and bags of polymers of ethylene, and 3923.21.00 is the statistical breakdown.

I recall CBP rulings that classify dog waste bags on rolls under 3923.21.0085 (other sacks and bags of ethylene polymers). A few rulings place similar bags in 3924.90 as household articles, but the majority position is 3923.21.0085.

Two points support this. The bags are on rolls and are dispensed for collecting waste, so they are conveyance articles. The description does not say whether they are polyethylene, but such bags typically are. There is also an antidumping duty order on polyethylene retail carrier bags from China, but that order does not cover these bags.
